decisions_made: Reconstructed SuspectCard.tscn with two explicit visual states: ClosedStateRoot (closed door textures door_01..09, 36px room number, special location icons) vs OpenStateRoot (card_outer_frame polaroid, role icon, suspect number, 15px role title, >=13px clue text, dead seal marker, function hand marker, accuse stamp, and reveal history toggle).
Strictly clamped all layout anchors to anchor_right <= 1.0 and anchor_bottom <= 1.0 in SuspectCard.tscn, completely eradicating the legacy 1.42 out-of-bounds clipping bug.
Eliminated the 5px micro-text shrinking bug in SuspectCardController.gd by defining bounded font tiers STATEMENT_FONT_TIERS = [16, 14, 13, 13] (minimum 13px) and updating obscured text to 13px.

Implemented CatenaryYarnLayer.gd as an isolated modular Node2D handling interactive pin connections, Verlet physical sag simulation (24 segments, 15 constraint runs, 0.98 damping), and click-drag wire management to avoid LOC bloat in VSCaseMainController.gd per ADR-0010.

Integrated selective original visual assets (board_desk_background, card frames, doors, pins, markers) and tactile audio feedback (card_flip.wav, pin_pop.wav, gavel_stamp.wav) into VSCaseMain.tscn and VSCaseMainController.gd.

Authored comprehensive Python test suite tests/test_detective_board_presentation.py with 8 automated assertions verifying scene hierarchy, anchor boundaries, font tiers, yarn API, audio integration, and smoke test contract compatibility without executing godot --headless on Windows per Rule #5.
omissions_and_simplifications: ACTIVE TRADE-OFF INTERROGATION FINDING 1 (Shift-Click Yarn Drag UX): To avoid interaction conflicts between left-click direct investigation and right-click suspect marking, dragging yarn connections requires holding SHIFT while left-clicking a card pin (or dragging and releasing over a target card pin). Right-clicking removes connections for that pin. This UX decision keeps primary gameplay controls uncluttered.

ACTIVE TRADE-OFF INTERROGATION FINDING 2 (Modular Yarn Extraction vs Monolith Refactoring): CatenaryYarnLayer.gd (262 LOC) was cleanly extracted to isolate Verlet physics and prevent exceeding line budgets. VSCaseMainController.gd remains in baseline_exemptions (1,754 LOC); full decomposition of VSCaseMainController into smaller sub-controllers was intentionally deferred to a dedicated milestone to minimize regression risk.

ACTIVE TRADE-OFF INTERROGATION FINDING 3 (Tactile Audio Fallback): Programmatic fallback instances and ResourceLoader.exists() checks are implemented for PinAudio, CardFlipAudio, and GavelAudio so gameplay functions normally even in test harnesses where audio drivers are unavailable.

ACTIVE TRADE-OFF INTERROGATION FINDING 4 (Headless Test Avoidance): In strict compliance with Engine Guard Rule #5 ('CẤM chạy godot --headless trực tiếp trên Windows'), all automated verification is performed via tests/test_detective_board_presentation.py inspecting scene structures, bounds, and GDScript contracts statically.
Confirmed zero hidden shortcuts, zero unmanaged workarounds, and 100% adherence to acceptance criteria and presentation separation invariants.
